title: Research: present-head I−G/2 forcing census — 18/18 checked entries need +2 (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. Open [#3601](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3601) and [#3610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3610) each price one present-head `I − G/2` entry and leave OQ2: whether every present-head target row needs +2 for its strict side-correction entry.

This package answers that OQ for the **primary** present-head entries of flags `{1,9,43}` on the **published** native-channel word, plus a deterministic sample of five further off-diagonal nonzero Gram sources per target (18 checked entries total; each present-head row has ~48 nonzero sources). Every insertion class is zero-mass obstructed for all 18. Under the inherited class-Z + even nested-transport convention, that is a non-private **lower bound of +2**. No counterexample in the sample. No correction words are constructed (so flag 9 has no attaining +2 word here, unlike the leave-alone bills for flags 1 and 43).

Primary feeders:

| Flag | Entry | Feeder | Head | Leave event | Insertion classes |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | `(7,0)` | `X7` | 387 | 1074 | 19 (published order) |
| 9 | `(23,4)` | `X58` | 333 | 745 | 25 |
| 43 | `(59,21)` | `X12` | 131 | 884 | 28 |

Flag-1 and flag-43 feeders match the leave-alone samples in #3610/#3601. Flag 9's feeder `X58:333` at leave 745 on the published chronology ([#3443](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3443)) is new (`outside_head_count=1` at that leave); the deferred flag-9 head-step repair is not reopened.

**Scoped obstruction census. No correction words. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/p104-present-head-side-correction-forcing-census/`
- Tip: `a6c3ae20abe0a15d781ee952e717d489552c9c66`
- Content tip: `293b90598af0e7632cdd398da7171c509091f17e`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **refined** — cross-entry obstruction census on the published word only

Closest priors: [#3610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3610), [#3601](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3601) (cite samples `X7:387` / `X12:131`; bills leave-alone), [#3443](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3443) (flag-9 published chronology; no feeder reuse), [#3532](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3532)/[#3508](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3508) (repairs leave-alone). Soft-overlap with #3601/#3610 verify builders is negligible (seq ≈0.03–0.04); independent scanners share frame/`need` idiom only (≈0.15–0.17). Obstruction tables are recomputed from pinned witness/Gram, not imported from those bills. Does not reopen deferred flag-9 repair / pinned-late / peeled-leaf / rho=0 / V45.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-present-head-side-correction-forcing-census/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-side-correction-forcing-census/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-side-correction-forcing-census/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-side-correction-forcing-census/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-present-head-side-correction-forcing-census
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_SIDE_CORRECTION_FORCING_CENSUS flags={1,9,43} entries=18/18 need_plus_two primary_feeders=X7:387,X58:333,X12:131 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_SIDE_CORRECTION_FORCING_CENSUS_INDEPENDENT flags={1,9,43} entries=18/18 need_plus_two primary_feeders=X7:387,X58:333,X12:131 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_SIDE_CORRECTION_FORCING_CENSUS_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-present-head-side-correction-forcing-census outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`. Duplicate JSON keys and temp-copy certificate/pin corruption are rejected.

## Open next questions

1. Full-row extension beyond the 18-entry sample on Y7/Y23/Y59 (~48 off-diagonal nonzero sources per row).
2. Flag-9 end-cut side-correction bill / private-copy discount on the published word (no co-hosted repair; would also give an attaining +2 word).
